reason: The device and card line draws the constant fallback when no authored states option matches; the old app and the Studio sim show the controller's title-cased state. state-text-core moves the line into ServerUIRemoteDeviceText.line, which falls back to the controller text.

The device line treats unknown as unavailable (EntityState.isUnavailable) and draws the unavailable text; the old app drew Unknown. Not covered by state-text-core, whose line also returns the unavailable text first.
Lock state opening: the new built-in lock style treats it as a moving state (Lock, lock.open, taps ignored); the old provider treated it as ready Unlock. Owner to confirm the new reading.
